drift.actual: The performance advisor reports unused_index informational findings immediately after creation
drift.resolution: Retain the reviewed foreign-key indexes and reassess usage after representative production traffic; do not remove them from an immediate post-create snapshot.

drift.expected: The migration marker remains closed to public access
drift.actual: The security advisor reports informational rls_enabled_no_policy for the marker table
drift.resolution: Keep the marker table non-public; change only through a separately reviewed operational-access migration.
